title: Verification Asymmetry: Lean 4 Formalization
description: Machine-checked Lean 4 and Mathlib formal companion for Verification Asymmetry under AI Substitution. The strict current-paper contract binds 26 formal manuscript fragments to 26 unique complete Lean declaration signatures and exact per-claim project-axiom sets, while classifying three interpretive fragments as scope-only.
